Days to show (1 = today only, 2 = today + tomorrow)
Max events shown in the preview
Show today's finished events, dimmed, above the now-line
Show a badge on the tab with the number of events left today

Hover delay before the preview opens (ms)
Delay before the preview closes after the mouse leaves (ms)
Minimum seconds between feed refreshes on hover
